All checks pass and the workspace is clean. Submitting.

**What changed this iteration**
- Rewrote `app/frontend/src/pages/GenreCategory.jsx` to match the pixel-decoded reference: full-bleed hero (78vh, first genre title's backdrop with left dark gradient), genre name as an overlay heading at top-left of the hero (top ~7vh, left ~8.3vw), compact featured-title content at bottom-left (title, match/year/maturity meta, white **Play** + gray **More Info** buttons), and — directly below the hero with no gap — a 6-column 16:9 grid (3.33vw margins, 6px gaps ≈ the measured 291px cards at pitch 297) with name + kind/year under each card; cards open the title modal. Honest empty state and the genre-not-found state are kept.
- Verified `TitleModal` (title detail + episodes) already matches the measured spec — no change needed.

**Validation**: `validate` → 14/14 checks, 13/15 contract 2xx (the 2 are intentional: `POST /api/my-list` empty→422, `DELETE /api/my-list/1`→404), 8/8 chain. Build clean; `node_modules`/`dist`/`__pycache__` removed from the snapshot.

**Still missing / caveats**: Without image viewing I can't pixel-verify exact font weights/positions on the new genre page; the decode was high-confidence for structure (hero height, overlay positions, 6×291 grid) but small details (genre-name font size, exact content spacing) are best estimates. The three dialog references (`rate_dialog`, `account_menu`, `shows_genres_menu`) remain "believed matched" from the iteration-2 rewrites, unverifiable by me here.
